entities.summary: Dubai Towers - Doha is a stalled supertall skyscraper with a roof height of 400 m (1,300 ft) developing in Doha, Qatar. The estimated cost of Dubai Towers - Doha is 2.3 billion Qatari Riyal. When completed, the structure would have been the tallest building in Qatar.
